items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'She's a friend. At least, you can say 'hello'.' ... 'Me and Joe Turner gonna get married.'

ctx.x: So, we moved over to this new hotel where she lived at, so we wanted to buy some clothes---some ties and shirts and stuff. So we didn't know nothin' about Chicago. We never been there before. So Louelly...she live in the hotel...my wife that I married this lady later on...she said that she would go downtown for us and pick up some ties an' stuff.
